title: Petkit Fountain Low-Water Alert
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petkit:status device_type=fountain
| stats count(eval(alert="low_water")) as low_water_alerts by device
| where low_water_alerts>0
| sort - low_water_alerts
description: Uses Petkit fountain status telemetry to monitor low-water alerts from smart fountains in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for hydration hardware that needs topping up or cleaning, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Petkit fountain status data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals low-water alerts from smart fountains so you can spot hydration hardware that needs topping up or cleaning before it becomes annoying.
